bio.name: Sumit Chauhan
bio.title: Data Analyst & AI Specialist
bio.summary: A 23-year-old Data Analyst & AI Specialist with a B.Sc. in Data Science (2025) and an M.Sc in Artificial Intelligence & Data Science (Completed 2026). Passionate about uncovering business patterns using Python, SQL, and Power BI.

education.degree: M.Sc in Artificial Intelligence & Data Science

experience.description: Undergoing hands-on industry training on real-world business datasets. Performing exploratory data analysis, data wrangling, cleaning anomalies, and building automated visualization dashboards for operational reporting.

projects.title: Customer Churn & Retention Model
projects.description: Built a predictive classification model using Scikit-Learn to identify high-risk customer cancellation signals before renewals, enabling proactive customer retention.
projects.impact: High classification accuracy with actionable feature importance.

projects.title: Executive Sales Performance Dashboard
projects.description: Designed an interactive Power BI dashboard featuring DAX measures to track monthly revenue run-rate, regional sales targets, profit margins, and cohort performance.
projects.impact: Replaced static spreadsheets with interactive multi-filter reports.

projects.title: E-Commerce Transaction EDA & RFM
projects.description: Extracted transaction records with complex SQL queries (CTEs, Window Functions) and grouped shoppers into RFM (Recency, Frequency, Monetary) cohorts for marketing campaigns.
projects.impact: Identified top 15% VIP customers generating over 55% of revenue.
